system_thesis_interpretation: Scientifically, this is a deliberately small protocol-feasibility assay, not a private-thought matching test and not an efficacy experiment. HARNESS and EXPERIENTIAL are the only on-policy systems: both are full agents with the same frozen base/bootstrap, canonical reconstructed packet, public feedback, common ledger/notebook/retrieval, tools, logical budgets, order, reset policy, and sleep cadence. EXPERIENTIAL alone receives the cumulative life-local q/v LoRA rebuilt from its sealed public acquisition records. Consequently the Stage-C question is narrow but meaningful: can the exact two-system wiring produce complete, sterile, score-valid observations under the prescribed recipe without an undeclared state or information channel? It does not ask whether a model's prose resembles private thought, whether ORIENT/THINK_ACT implements consciousness, or whether the LoRA is a generally superior memory carrier.
graph_delta_interpretation: The decisive graph is public acquisition state -> reconstructed ORIENT packet -> bounded common retrieval -> reconstructed THINK_ACT packet -> one typed public operation -> sealed public event -> deterministic SLEEP compiler -> one EXPERIENTIAL LoRA -> cold, quarantined target forks. The matching HARNESS fork at each checkpoint closes the primary whole-harness measurement that v2 lacked. Adapter-off and final semantic binding-shuffled forks are EXPERIENTIAL-only sterile diagnostics, not additional learning agents. The graph therefore measures feasibility of a particular whole-system contrast and diagnostic construction, while keeping component attribution out of scope. The atomized separation of adapter bytes, source evidence, workspace, telemetry, target/evaluator material, labels, and ephemeral process state is essential: a packet-level arm cue or target-to-life return path would make even a feasibility report invalid.
loop_delta_interpretation: ORIENT and THINK_ACT are two mandatory phases of one recurrent invocation loop, not two agents: each is freshly reconstructed from declared state, ORIENT may only choose finite focus/recall labels, and THINK_ACT alone emits one operation. This operationalizes context as bounded explicit working state without treating it as a measurement of inner experience. SLEEP after acquisition tasks 4 and 8 is deterministic supervision compilation, not a second model or an evaluator: it uses only EXPERIENTIAL's sealed public acquisition prefix, has finite operational loss targets, rebuilds a clean-base rank-16 q/v LoRA with reset optimizer, publishes atomically, and destroys trainer/process/cache/KV state. The ledger/notebook and immutable receipts may persist within a life as common nonparametric source evidence; the LoRA alone is adaptive parameter state across sleep. The protocol correctly distinguishes exact compilation bytes, same-stack numerical tolerance, and behavioral cold-load reproducibility. A failure at any gate ends this recipe rather than authorizing retry, tuning, repair, or target-informed selection.
claim_delta_interpretation: The proposed claim boundary is appropriate for the pilot. IrInstructionCountOz is the sole reward-space identifier; the descriptive score is S_i,k=(I_0-min_{j<=k,valid} I_i,j)/(I_0-I_Oz), with S_i,k=0 before any valid state, a finite strictly positive denominator requirement, and G_i=(1/6) sum_{k=1..6} S_i,k. Thus G is a six-decision discrete area-under-the-best-so-far-score curve, not wall-clock-time AUC and not a functional-correctness result. Wall time, FLOPs, memory, calls, tokens, cache events, and training work are out-of-band resource observations, while logical counters constrain the agent but do not establish time-awareness as a scientific construct. The POJ104 split is fit-gated: four public-static relation groups each require two acquisition candidates, one held-out target, two spares, target-blind positive headroom, and mechanical exact/near-neighbor exclusions before model calls. At checkpoint c, D_HE,c=mean_i(G_EXPERIENTIAL,i,c-G_HARNESS,i,c) is a raw four-target within-one-life descriptive contrast, not an arm effect or an AUC/lifetime slope estimate. D_off,c and final D_shuf are secondary adapter-byte and post-selection state-operation-binding diagnostics. No result validates temporal credit, outcome selection, private thought, a causal mechanism, superiority to text/RAG/organized memory, saturation, flywheel growth, population behavior, or a paper claim.
visibility_matrix_interpretation: The matrix supports the intended no-private-thought test because it makes finite operational labels and their token mask distinct from prose and unparsed output. Reason, rationale, strategy, active-question text, hypothesis, prediction, uncertainty, expected effect, free text, and unparsed output are excluded from loss-one targets, endpoints, and promotion criteria; public typed operations and official public outcomes are the evidence channels. Both primary wakes receive the same model-visible packet and common within-life source-evidence interface; only opaque mounted adapter bytes vary below packet construction. Target forks receive their target-local packet and assignment only, never a life retriever, arm/checkpoint label, target role, evaluator/reference data, telemetry, cache/RNG/process state, or return path. This permits a clean test of declared packet and fork feasibility without demanding that the first pilot solve every possible external-memory or transport alternative.
acceptance_test_interpretation: T01A-T04A are the prerequisite internal-validity package: canonical one-loop packet assembly, finite operational-only masks, deterministic outcome-filtered compiler semantics, explicit determinism tiers, adaptive-versus-source state boundaries, cold-load behavior, and atomized matched-fork noninterference. They test whether a private-thought or hidden-state route has been excluded, not whether the learned recipe is scientifically correct. T05A-T06A make CompilerGym/POJ104 conditional and executable: unchanged local official 0.2.5/LLVM10 bytes must expose IrInstructionCountOz and the declared compact observation/action semantics; the exact G, epsilon, invalid/missing rule, split, spares, public relatedness, nonduplication, and headroom must bind before targets open, then fresh offline replay must reproduce the semantics. T07A is exactly the right modest pre-target test for a fixed rank-16 q/v recipe: acquisition-only rows must give valid operations, nonzero target-token gradients, fixed touches/updates, numerical health, same-stack tolerance, behavioral cold-load, and a pre-target s_canary/m, with no sweep or preservation update. T08A is then a complete one-pair wiring report, requiring every raw cell and D_HE,c with indeterminate-cell disclosure; its only valid outputs are WIRING_FAILURE, RECIPE_FEASIBLE_DESCRIPTIVE, or INDETERMINATE. T09A correctly limits null-adapter and semantic derangement results to secondary diagnostics, and removal of preservation rows makes adapter-off free of that former confound. T10A requires disclosure of validity/style/reuse/transport explanations and omitted controls. T11A reserves replication, direct outcome-selection intervention, life-level analysis, and stronger transport controls for a new Stage-D change. T12A preserves the required independent review and exact scoped human authority without needlessly requiring a full factorial, paper-level power, or repeated permission prompts inside an already-ratified A-through-C ladder.
assumptions: The exact change SHA-256 is 9b314360c9deff631ad0627a22290cec66ff1883d71beecf031d1a0fc50753bd and every context-file hash recorded here was independently verified before this artifact was written.

CompilerGym 0.2.5, LLVM 10, benchmark://poj104-v1, IrInstructionCountOz, legal action semantics, and the required catalog/split bytes are candidates only until T05A and T06A pass; their names do not establish availability or semantic fitness.

The first sorted public-static 8/4 relation split, target-blind positive-headroom rule, epsilon, missing-cell rule, s_canary, margin, and run constants will be sealed before target opening and are not selected from target outcomes.

G is interpreted as a bounded six-decision best-so-far instruction-count trajectory summary. Checkpoint values and four targets are nested observations in one paired life, not independent target or time replications.

All persistent nonparametric source evidence is common in kind and capped by the declared harness; it supports parity within this harness only, not a comparison against every text, RAG, raw-LoRA, native-context, or organized-memory alternative.

The deterministic row writer is supervised by public outcome-filtered records and finite operational targets. Its reproducibility, adapter-off result, and post-selection semantic shuffle do not establish that temporal eligibility or outcome selection is causally correct.
Time is represented for agent control by declared logical counters; physical latency and compute are retained only for resource accounting and are not model-visible outcome variables.

ambiguities.question: Will the independently reviewed pre-target manifest make the serializer/parser, score epsilon, invalid/timeout classification, canonical relation threshold, compatible semantic-equivalence strata, seed policy, numerical tolerance, s_canary, and margin executable without filling material details in after target opening?
ambiguities.impact: These bytes determine whether D_HE,c, D_off,c, D_shuf, indeterminate cells, and the recipe-feasibility disposition are reproducible rather than post-hoc descriptions.

ambiguities.question: Can the official POJ104/LLVM environment establish only deterministic compiler-state semantics, or is any program-functional-correctness property intended to be inferred?
ambiguities.impact: The specified metric is LLVM IR instruction-count improvement relative to -Oz; it does not by itself prove source-program behavior or justify a functional-correctness claim.

ambiguities.question: Which presentation of wall time, GPU/CPU work, adapter loading, compilation, retrieval, and cache effects will accompany the logical-parity ledger?
ambiguities.impact: The resource ledger is needed to describe feasibility and cost honestly, but must remain separate from model-visible context and cannot turn one pilot into a compute-normalized superiority result.

open_questions: Will Rohin ratify only the exact bounded A-through-C feasibility ladder after the independent review and machine-verifiable gates, with no authorization inferred from this interpretation?

Will the pre-target manifest explicitly retain the stated non-claim boundary: one common-order paired life may report wiring/recipe feasibility and diagnostics, but no causal-credit, mechanism, lifetime, superiority, or population conclusion?

If the unchanged local CompilerGym/LLVM/POJ104 substrate, score/split construction, acquisition-only recipe fit, or sterile-fork integrity fails, will the program stop rather than repair, substitute, tune, or expose targets under this change?
